   FROM (access_permissions ap

  WHERE ((ap.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (ap.bundle_id = notes.bundle_id) AND (ap.status = 'active'::access_status) AND (p.status = 'active'::account_status) AND ((ap.expires_at IS NULL) OR (ap.expires_at > now()))))))
